topPick.thesis: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) is trading at 15.7x P/E, a 10% discount to its sector average of 17.5x; RSI at 65 reflects healthy bullish momentum without overextension. Three-month price momentum of +46.4% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +348% year-on-year, underpinned by a bearish MACD signal suggesting near-term caution is warranted. Composite score of 81/100 places MPC in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +30.1% over the past quarter.
